decisions.statement: A locked buy rule is refused an update or a deletion unless that call says `--force`.
The id is said as a word rather than at its flag.
A call saying no id is refused, asking for the id by its placeholder.
A `--` makes the word after it the id rather than a flag this takes none of.
Words this takes none of are all named in one refusal.
Locking a buy rule already locked changes nothing.
An id no buy rule carries refuses the call.

definition: the command locking a buy rule named by its id
